blocks.html: On roof signs, projecting signs, and marquee signs required to be constructed of noncombustible materials, if the display surface does not exceed 150 square feet (13.9 m 2 ), the entire display surface shall be permitted to be covered by approved plastic. If the area of a display surface exceeds 150 square feet (13.9 m 2 ), the area occupied or covered by approved plastics shall be limited to 150 square feet (13.9 m 2 ) plus 25 percent of the difference between 150 square feet (13.9 m 2 ) and the total area of display surface. The area of plastic on a display surface shall not in any case exceed 575 square feet (53.4 m 2 ), unless approved by the commissioner.
